headline_findings.finding: The authoring ontology gate validates only DECLARED enum values and DECLARED exact-ref kinds. A leaf declared UNBOUNDED bypasses it entirely, and no layer validates the value: M3 accepts any string (m3:658-660) or kind (m3:667-669) and copies the payload into the positive object (m3:931).

Two receipt claims are false at the machinery level: (a) 02_VOCABULARY_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT.json numeric_ceiling.consequence - 'no numeric ... magnitude can be authored through any positive path' (P4 disproves); (b) 01_REPAIR_MATRIX.json R2 and 00_RETURN.md R2 - the whole semantic class is blocked and strong nouns/numeric leaves are refused (true only for closed leaves; P5 shows ten accepted actor-semantic labels).

The V556_INTERACTION_RELATION family is authorable and positively evaluable through the generic path with TD_R03 §5 forbidden-premise names inside the positive object's payload (probe P7). The return asserts the family is lawfully VALID_EMPTY and no fabricated positive relation kind exists; that is true of the shipped canary registry, not of the machinery. The same mechanism leaves V556_ATTRACTOR_PREREQUISITE authorable.

The repaired court has no witness for the commission's attack #2: no UNBOUNDED payload-value test, no UNBOUNDED exact-ref-kind test, no string-riding magnitude test, no generic-path interaction/attractor authoring test. The numeric test proves only that node TYPES are refused.

The actor-semantic role token list is not whole-class. Of 12 further actor-semantic candidates, 10 are accepted (SELF_MODEL, IDENTITY_COMMITMENT, INNER_STATE, SUBJECTIVE_MEANING, WORLDVIEW, TEMPERAMENT, STRUCTURAL_SELF, HABITUS, DISPOSITION, ORIENTATION).

TOPOLOGY_CANARY_SHAPE_LABEL and TOPOLOGY_CANARY_F2_CLAIM exist only in snapshot(), so the emitted rule/schema/contract material does not declare itself illustrative; and validate_payload_against_participants is not called on any production path.

author_governed_rule checks binding_ref kind and content_hash but not object_id; ADMITTED_OBJECTIVE_SCHEMA_CLASSES admits actor-named classes whose roles the tranche excludes and nothing links class to family; a hand-built ResultContractBinding is stored unfrozen.

The full-suite regression baseline (227/2293/53, 280 IDs) could not be independently reproduced in this environment (observed 223/2263/59). Reported as reconstructed, not certified. A structural substitute is supplied: the change set is two files, no module imports the changed module, the seam is byte-identical, and the +18 passed delta reconciles to 17->35.

Extend the role refusal to the class the receipt claims, or narrow the claim. The ten accepted labels are the evidence.

Carry the illustrative/no-F2 labels in the emitted material or restate the receipt; decide whether the payload-binding helper is enforcement (wire it in) or a court helper (stop describing it as enforcement).
